summary: Segment 5 of 8 of a raw Maude screen recording: this stretch is driven entirely by the AI chat agent (Claude Code), not the manual slider-based Photo Editor panel — it locates the source photo, runs automatic background removal, confirms and compresses the cutout, then composites it into a pre-built 'MVP' Instagram sports-card template. The standout moment is a clean ~3s before/after flip around 16-19s where the template goes from flat/text-only to a fully composited hero card. After that the canvas holds static on the finished card for roughly 30s while the agent narrates verification/polish steps with no new visual information, then ends with the assistant flipping to a 'Ready' state and an empty chat input, cueing the human to type the next edit. No manual slider or drag-to-edit UI appears anywhere in this segment.
